rounds.q: In The 12 Days of Christmas, gifts repeat daily. How many are given in all?
rounds.why: Count every repeat and you get 12 partridges, 42 swans and 40 gold rings.
rounds.src: PNC Christmas Price Index, True Cost of Christmas (2025 edition; the count is fixed by the song)
rounds.fun: 364 gifts in all, with 42 swans and 40 gold rings. Good luck wrapping those!

rounds.q: What % of holiday purchases do US stores expect shoppers to return?
rounds.why: That was the 2025 forecast. Online orders bounce back more: about 19% get returned.
rounds.src: National Retail Federation and Happy Returns, 2025 Retail Returns Landscape (Oct 2025, latest edition found)
rounds.fun: About 1 in 6 holiday buys heads back to the store. Keep that receipt!

rounds.q: How much does the average American plan to spend on holiday gifts this year?
rounds.why: About a third of Americans (36%) plan to spend $1,000 or more on gifts.
rounds.src: Gallup, Holiday Shopping Plans poll (Oct 2026 data)
rounds.fun: $1,011 on gifts! About a third of us plan to spend $1,000 or more.

rounds.q: What year did the modern gift wrap business get its start in the US?
rounds.why: A Kansas City shop sold out of tissue paper at Christmas and sold fancy envelope linings instead.
rounds.src: Hallmark Cards, company history (1917); NPR/KCUR, The History of Gift Wrap (Dec 2017)
rounds.fun: In 1917 a shop ran out of tissue paper, so fancy envelope linings saved Christmas.

rounds.q: The Statue of Liberty was a gift from France. How many crates did it ship in?
rounds.why: It crossed the ocean in 350 pieces and reached New York Harbor in June 1885.
rounds.src: Library of Congress blog, This Day in History: Statue of Liberty (June 2017); National Park Service
rounds.fun: A gift in 350 pieces packed into 214 crates. Some assembly required!
